articles.title: Greek Soldiers Among Alleged Leaders of $8M Crypto Pyramid Scheme
articles.description: An association for AI enthusiasts was allegedly the recruiting vehicle, and two anonymous tips to a government portal started the case.

articles.title: OKX and NYSE Owner ICE Plan 24/7 Tokenized Stock Trading Under SEC Exemption
articles.description: Filed under the SEC's new Innovation Exemption, the notice lists more than 60 stocks, including Nvidia and SpaceX, paired with stablecoins.

articles.title: Trump Taps Jay Clayton, the SEC Chair Who Sued Ripple, to Lead AI Push
articles.description: President Trump named a new "Super Intelligence Force" to coordinate federal AI policy, with Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton at the helm. As SEC chair, Clayton launched crypto lawsuits including the agency's case against Ripple.

articles.title: Banking Group Sues to Block Crypto's 'Side Door' Into the Banking System
articles.description: The Independent Community Bankers of America argues the OCC's national trust charters give crypto firms a "side door into the banking system" without the safeguards that bind traditional banks.

articles.title: 'Uptober' Starts Green as Bitcoin ETFs Draw $134 Million
articles.description: Spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $134.4 million over the first two trading days of October, rebounding from a Sept. 30 outflow as a weak jobs report cooled Fed rate-hike bets.

articles.title: 'We Have Identified You, Sir': Near Intents Recovers $3.8 Million After 48-Hour Ultimatum
articles.description: Near Intents said the roughly $3.8 million drained in an exploit on Thursday was returned in full, a day after the team said it had identified the attacker and gave them 48 hours to return the funds.

articles.title: Chainalysis Used AI to Trace the $387M Bitget Hack Back to North Korea
articles.description: The firm says the Sept. 24 breach pushed North Korea's 2026 crypto haul past $1 billion, and detailed how it used in-house AI to trace the stolen funds across four blockchains in a race against the attackers.

articles.title: OpenAI Banned PewDiePie Twice While He Built Ajax, an Uncensored AI That Will Run on Your PC
articles.description: The YouTuber says OpenAI suspended his account twice while he trained a small, uncensored model built to run on your own computer.

articles.title: Trump Is Hosting Yet Another Meme Coin Dinner: Here Are the Details
articles.description: The TRUMP meme coin project is inviting its top 185 holders to a Nov. 22 gala dinner with President Trump two weeks after ethics disputes over his crypto interests helped stall the Clarity Act in the Senate.

articles.title: The Pope Has Thoughts on AI Art—And They're Not Flattering
articles.description: The pontiff says algorithms "lack the spark of humanity," and the Vatican wants to renew an alliance with artists and cultural institutions to protect it.

articles.title: California Subpoenas OpenAI Over AI Models That Hacked Their Way Out of a Test
articles.description: California's attorney general wants answers from OpenAI about AI models that escaped a locked test environment and hacked Hugging Face—and whether the company can be held legally accountable.

articles.title: Ethereum Now Lets You Pay for AI Without Revealing Who You Are
articles.description: Ethereum's zkAPI lets users prepay in USDC and query AI models through cryptographic proofs, so no single party sees both who they are and what they ask.

articles.title: Circle Pushes Back on MiCA's Bank-Deposit Mandate for Stablecoins
articles.description: The USDC issuer told the European Commission that MiCA's reserve mandates and concentration caps keep the largest global stablecoins outside Europe's perimeter—siding with the ECB in calling for more flexible rules.

articles.title: This AI Is Already Fooling People on Video Calls Into Thinking It's Human, Company Says
articles.description: Tavus says 26 of 54 people on a one-minute video call thought its new Griffin model was human. The results are the company's own, and the model isn't going to retail customers yet.

articles.title: Once a $2.3 Billion Network, Ethereum Layer-2 Blast Is Shutting Down
articles.description: Blast said operating costs now exceed the revenue its Ethereum layer-2 generates and asked users to withdraw their assets to mainnet before Oct. 26.

articles.title: Nvidia Hits Record High as Market Value Reaches $5.7 Trillion
articles.description: The AI chipmaker's stock topped its May peak on Friday, helped by a record $150 billion buyback and a weak jobs report that cooled bets on Fed rate hikes.

articles.title: Bitcoin Heads Higher on Macro Moves: Where Does BTC Go Next?
articles.description: A jobs report miss just erased the odds of an October rate hike, and BTC is now knocking on the door of its yearly ceiling.

articles.title: 'Uptober' Off With a Bang as Bitcoin Surges to $86K
articles.description: Cooler inflation and two dovish Fed speakers have shifted the odds toward a rate hold, with payrolls due and CPI landing on October 14.

articles.title: Morning Minute: NEAR Intents Hacked for $3.8M - Was It A Bullish Hack?
articles.description: Hacks are never good, but a rapid response, user compensation and 1-hour bug fixing seems to top the spectrum of team reactions.

articles.title: US Designates Russia's A7 Network as Transnational Criminal Organization
articles.description: Treasury's proposed rule aims to cut A7's front companies off from U.S. finance—including crypto, where its ruble token moved $179 billion.

articles.title: Spanish Police Arrest 16-Year-Old Accused of Running KillSec Ransomware Group
articles.description: A second suspect faces extradition to Puerto Rico, while Investigators are tracing the proceeds of ransoms the group demanded in crypto.

articles.title: Zcash Drops 21% From Recent High—Here’s Why the Rally May Not Be Over
articles.description: ZEC is 21% off its $1,698 peak after ETF outflows and a suspected North Korean heist routed money through its shielded pool. Is the run over, or will traders buy the dip?

articles.title: SEC Proposes Rules to Clear Up How Advisers and Funds Can Hold Crypto
articles.description: The proposal would let advisers and funds use state trust companies as custodians and permit self-custody under certain conditions, aiming to replace years of ambiguity with a clear compliance path.

articles.title: Reddit Is Killing RSS Feeds and Public API Access to Fight AI Scrapers
articles.description: Reddit RSS dies November 13 and outside apps lose their data pipeline by March 2027. Reddit blames scraping bots, though it licenses its own content to AI companies.

articles.title: OpenAI Says People Linked to China's Moonshot Tried to Copy Its AI's Hidden Reasoning
articles.description: OpenAI says it disrupted a campaign involving 15,000+ users and ties a core cluster to people associated with Moonshot, the startup behind Kimi.

articles.title: Meta Pushes Back on Claim That Muse AI Read a User's Messages Without Consent
articles.description: Communications chief Andy Stone said reading Messages requires two permissions the user controls, disputing a journalist who reported Muse synced his texts despite his settings.

articles.title: The 'Largest Pure-Play' XRP Treasury Is About to Go Public
articles.description: Shareholders approved Evernorth's merger with Armada Acquisition Corp. II, clearing the way for the Ripple-backed firm to begin trading Oct. 8 with a stash of roughly 473 million XRP.

articles.title: OpenAI Fires Three Safety Researchers Over Alleged Leak to Outside Group
articles.description: OpenAI says the three broke its rules on handling sensitive information. The exits land after months of rogue-agent incidents, a trail of safety-team departures, and a new lawsuit.

articles.title: It's the Start of Uptober. Will Bitcoin Live Up to It?
articles.description: Bitcoin enters its historically strongest month after a record-pace September, but a Fed hike and 5.3% Treasury yields are testing the bulls.

articles.title: Illinois Delays Controversial Crypto Tax Amid Industry Lawsuit
articles.description: Illinois officials and crypto groups jointly asked a state court to delay the 0.2% Digital Asset Tax from Jan. 1 to July 1, 2027, while a legal challenge continues.

articles.title: Near Intents Hacked for $3.8M Days After Denying North Korea-Linked Bitget Hacker
articles.description: Near Intents froze its cross-chain swaps after a bug let an attacker drain about $3.8 million. The company promised to repay every user.

articles.title: Minecraft, Candy Crush Among 11 Games in EU Virtual Currency Crackdown
articles.description: The guidelines exclude cryptocurrencies, leaving tokens outside a regime written for currencies bought with real money inside games.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Crypto Gives Up on Congress and Goes After Senators
articles.description: Plus, a major MetaMask security event has crypto natives on edge as details trickle out.

articles.title: Citi Lifts 12-Month Bitcoin Target to $113K, Ethereum to $3K
articles.description: The bank has revised its 12-month target for BTC up from $82K, though it remains about 10% below Bitcoin's October 2025 record.

articles.title: MetaMask Exits Lido Validators Amid Infrastructure ‘Security Incident’
articles.description: The wallet says it has found no immediate threat to user wallets, but the ETH it is pulling out of Lido could take 45 days to return.

articles.title: EU Presses Binance Over ‘Reverse Solicitation’ Exemption for Users: Report
articles.description: Regulators are probing how the exchange keeps serving EU customers from Abu Dhabi, months after it lost its MiCA registrations.

articles.title: Gemini 4 Is Here, and Google’s Flagship Tops All Other AI Models on Cybersecurity
articles.description: Gemini 4 Argon tops 12 of 18 benchmarks in Google's own table, writes a million tokens per reply and resists hijacking best. Cyber defenders get it first, with the guardrails off.

articles.title: Dogecoin Is Getting Apps as DogeOS Opens Its Public Testnet
articles.description: The team behind the MyDoge wallet opened a public test of DogeOS, a layer that lets developers build lending platforms and games on top of the meme coin network.
